subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu direct session can become unusable after /reset or /new and fall back to generic 'Something went wrong...' while session index points to missing transcript IDs

question: Which reset/new recovery invariant should OpenClaw enforce for direct sessions after a failed run?
rationale: The bug is concrete, but the product contract determines whether reset/new should pre-create transcripts, preserve the prior mapping until durability, or repair missing family members later.

options.title: Transcript-first rotation
options.body: Create or replay the new transcript header before publishing the new session ID to the store, active run, queue, or usage family.

options.title: Preserve until durable
options.body: Keep the previous valid session entry authoritative until the first append or replay succeeds, then rotate lineage.

options.title: Repair on detection
options.body: Allow lazy transcript creation but detect missing family members and remap or prune them with explicit recovery copy.

recommendation.title: Transcript-first rotation
recommendation.body: Create or replay the new transcript header before publishing the new session ID to the store, active run, queue, or usage family.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent session lifecycle seams are the closest owner boundary for deciding and implementing the invariant.
